senses.en: multiplied by a thousand

example.en: The company saw a thousandfold increase in profits.
example.zh: 公司利润增长了千倍。

senses.en: by a thousand times

example.en: The trouble he caused was repaid thousandfold in suffering.
example.zh: 他造成的麻烦以千倍的痛苦偿还了。

senses.en: the use of standard containers for transporting goods

example.en: Containerization made global shipping much cheaper.
example.zh: 集装箱化使全球运输成本大大降低。

senses.en: a place where children without parents are cared for

example.en: She grew up in an orphanage after losing her parents.
example.zh: 她失去父母后在孤儿院长大。

senses.en: a group of similar things held or gathered together
senses.zh: 一束；一串；一群（同类事物）

example.en: He gave her a bunch of flowers.
example.zh: 他送给她一束花。

senses.en: an informal group of people

example.en: A bunch of friends met at the café.
example.zh: 一群朋友在咖啡馆见面。

senses.en: to gather or cause to gather into a cluster

example.en: The sheep bunched together in the cold.
example.zh: 羊群在寒冷中挤在一起。

senses.en: a mature female domestic cattle animal

example.en: The cow stood quietly in the field.
example.zh: 那头母牛静静地站在田里。

senses.en: to frighten or intimidate someone so that they become submissive

example.en: The loud shouting cowed the new employees.
example.zh: 大声喊叫吓住了新员工。

senses.en: a mature female of some large mammals, such as elephants and whales
senses.zh: （象、鲸等大型哺乳动物的）母兽

example.en: The elephant was a cow with a young calf beside her.
example.zh: 那头大象是一头母象，身边带着一头幼崽。

senses.en: A strange, frightening imaginary creature, often large and made of different animal or human parts.
senses.zh: 一种怪异可怕的想象生物，通常体型巨大，由不同动物或人的部分组成。

example.en: The child drew a monster with three eyes and wings.
example.zh: 那个孩子画了一个长着三只眼睛和翅膀的怪物。

senses.en: A person or thing that is unusually large, powerful, or frightening.
senses.zh: 异常巨大、强大或可怕的人或物。

example.en: The old truck was a monster, but it could carry heavy loads.
example.zh: 那辆旧卡车是个庞然大物，但能运载重物。

senses.en: A very cruel or evil person.

example.en: He was called a monster for his cruelty.
example.zh: 他因残忍而被称为恶魔。

senses.en: to carry out a plan, order, or procedure

example.en: The team will execute the plan next week.
example.zh: 团队将于下周执行该计划。

senses.en: to run a computer program or instruction

example.en: This software can execute complex instructions quickly.
example.zh: 这款软件能快速执行复杂指令。

senses.en: to kill someone as a legal punishment

example.en: Some countries still execute prisoners.
example.zh: 一些国家仍然处决囚犯。

senses.en: to reduce pain, stress, or an unpleasant feeling

example.en: This medicine will relieve your headache.
example.zh: 这种药会缓解你的头痛。

senses.en: to free someone from a duty by taking their place

example.en: The nurse came to relieve me at midnight.
example.zh: 护士半夜来接替我。

senses.en: to ease a problem or burden, often by providing help or money

example.en: The charity aims to relieve poverty in rural areas.
example.zh: 该慈善机构旨在缓解农村地区的贫困。

senses.en: a group of twelve things

example.en: She bought a dozen eggs.
example.zh: 她买了一打鸡蛋。

senses.en: a large number of people or things

example.en: Dozens of people waited outside.
example.zh: 许多人在外面等候。

senses.en: a small round mark, especially a dirty mark

example.en: There was a small spot of ink on the page.
example.zh: 页面上有一个小墨点。

senses.en: a particular place or location

example.en: We found a quiet spot by the river.
example.zh: 我们在河边找到了一个安静的地方。

senses.en: to see or notice someone or something

example.en: She spotted a bird in the tree.
example.zh: 她发现树上有只鸟。

senses.en: belonging to a person from birth, especially as a first language or original home

example.en: English is her native language.
example.zh: 英语是她的母语。

senses.en: growing or living naturally in a particular place
senses.zh: 原产于某地的；本地生长的

example.en: This plant is native to the region.
example.zh: 这种植物原产于该地区。

senses.en: a person born in a particular place

example.en: She is a native of this city.
example.zh: 她是这座城市的本地人。

senses.en: the lowest part or surface of something

example.en: The keys are at the bottom of the bag.
example.zh: 钥匙在包的底部。

senses.en: the part of the body that you sit on

example.en: He slipped and landed on his bottom.
example.zh: 他滑倒了，屁股着地。

senses.en: in the lowest position

example.en: The books are on the bottom shelf.
example.zh: 书在最底层的架子上。

senses.en: To mention or quote a source, book, or author as support for what you say.

example.en: Please cite your sources at the end of the report.
example.zh: 请在报告末尾注明引用来源。

senses.en: To mention someone or something as an example or reason.

example.en: The report cites high costs as the main reason for the delay.
example.zh: 报告把高昂成本列为延误的主要原因。

senses.en: To praise someone officially, especially for bravery.

example.en: The soldier was cited for bravery after the rescue.
example.zh: 这名士兵在救援后因英勇行为受到嘉奖。

senses.en: the act of opposing or fighting against something

example.en: The plan met with strong resistance from local residents.
example.zh: 该计划遭到当地居民的强烈反对。

senses.en: the ability to withstand a force, illness, or bad effect

example.en: Regular exercise can improve the body's resistance to illness.
example.zh: 规律锻炼可以增强身体对疾病的抵抗力。

senses.en: the opposition of a material to the flow of electric current

example.en: Copper has low electrical resistance.
example.zh: 铜的电阻很低。

senses.en: to remember something; to call back to mind

example.en: I can't recollect where I left my keys.
example.zh: 我想不起来把钥匙放在哪儿了。

collocations: as far as I can recollect

senses.en: relating to a city or town

example.en: The new civic center opened downtown last year.
example.zh: 新的市民中心去年在市中心开放了。

senses.en: relating to citizens or citizenship

example.en: Voting is an important civic duty.
example.zh: 投票是一项重要的公民义务。

senses.en: the railway system that runs below the ground in a city (British English)

example.en: She takes the underground to work every day.
example.zh: 她每天乘地铁上班。

senses.en: a secret group working against a government or occupying force

example.en: The underground helped prisoners escape during the war.
example.zh: 战时地下组织帮助囚犯逃脱。

senses.en: below the surface of the ground, or secret and hidden

example.en: The cables were placed in an underground tunnel.
example.zh: 电缆被铺设在地下隧道里。

senses.en: beneath the ground, or in secret

example.en: The animal lives underground to stay safe.
example.zh: 这种动物生活在地下以求安全。

senses.en: the capital and largest city of Greece

example.en: Athens is famous for its ancient ruins.
example.zh: 雅典以古老的遗迹闻名。

senses.en: a strong focused lamp that lights a small area, especially on a stage

example.en: The singer stood alone in the spotlight.
example.zh: 歌手独自站在聚光灯下。

senses.en: intense public attention

example.en: The scandal put the company in the spotlight.
example.zh: 丑闻使这家公司成为焦点。

senses.en: to draw special attention to something

example.en: The report spotlights the problem of unemployment.
example.zh: 该报告聚焦失业问题。

senses.en: a formal legal charge accusing someone of a crime

example.en: The grand jury returned an indictment against the company.
example.zh: 大陪审团对该公司提起了正式起诉。

senses.en: a strong sign that something is wrong or bad
senses.zh: （对某事的）有力谴责，表明有问题的事例

example.en: The poor exam results are an indictment of the school system.
example.zh: 糟糕的考试成绩是对学校制度的有力控诉。

senses.en: a game where people buy numbered tickets and prizes are drawn at random

example.en: He buys a lottery ticket every week hoping to win.
example.zh: 他每周都买一张彩票，希望能中奖。

senses.en: a situation whose outcome depends entirely on chance
senses.zh: 难以预料的事；碰运气的事

example.en: Finding a cheap apartment in the city is a lottery.
example.zh: 在城市里找到便宜的房子全凭运气。

senses.en: the basic unit of currency in Kenya, Tanzania, Uganda and some other African countries
senses.zh: 先令（肯尼亚、坦桑尼亚、乌干达等国的货币单位）

example.en: A cup of tea costs fifty shillings at the market.
example.zh: 市场上一杯茶要五十先令。

senses.en: a former British coin worth twelve old pence, used until 1971
senses.zh: 先令（英国旧时硬币，1971年前使用）

example.en: In the 1960s, a bus ticket in London cost about a shilling.
example.zh: 二十世纪六十年代，在伦敦一张公交车票大约花一先令。

senses.en: having too much flesh on the body; overweight

example.en: Regular exercise helped him become less fat and more healthy.
example.zh: 经常锻炼帮助他变得不那么胖，也更健康了。

senses.en: an oily substance found in the bodies of animals and in some plants, used for energy and stored in body tissue

example.en: Butter contains a lot of fat.
example.zh: 黄油含有大量脂肪。

senses.en: thick or wide in diameter

example.en: He wrote his name with a fat marker.
example.zh: 他用一支粗头记号笔写下自己的名字。

senses.en: a male given name

example.en: Arthur is a popular name in Britain.
example.zh: 亚瑟是英国常见的名字。

senses.en: the legendary king of the Britons, leader of the Knights of the Round Table
senses.zh: 亚瑟王（传说中不列颠国王，圆桌骑士团首领）

example.en: The legends of Arthur and his knights are famous in English literature.
example.zh: 亚瑟王及其骑士的传说在英国文学中很有名。

senses.en: comparative of close: at a shorter distance

example.en: Please move your chair closer to the table.
example.zh: 请把你的椅子挪得离桌子更近一些。

senses.en: comparative of close: nearer in distance, time, or relationship

example.en: The store is closer than I thought.
example.zh: 这家店比我想的更近。

senses.en: a pitcher who finishes a baseball game to protect a lead

example.en: The closer saved the game in the ninth inning.
example.zh: 这位终结者在第九局守住了比赛。

senses.en: a large, brightly colored handkerchief, often worn around the neck or head

example.en: He wore a red bandanna around his neck.
example.zh: 他脖子上系着一条红色的大手帕。

senses.en: the study of the structure and form of animals and plants

example.en: She studies plant morphology at the university.
example.zh: 她在大学研究植物形态学。

senses.en: the study of how words are formed in a language

example.en: English morphology explains how plurals are formed.
example.zh: 英语形态学解释了复数是如何构成的。

senses.en: existing in bodily form; a perfect example of a quality in human form
senses.zh: 化身的；…的化身（仅作表语）

example.en: Many saw the young leader as evil incarnate.
example.zh: 许多人视这位年轻领袖为邪恶的化身。

senses.en: to represent a quality or idea in a physical or concrete form

example.en: Her paintings incarnate the spirit of the city.
example.zh: 她的画作体现了这座城市的精神。

senses.en: a large long-tailed game bird often hunted

example.en: A pheasant suddenly flew up from the field.
example.zh: 一只野鸡突然从田里飞起。

senses.en: the highest singing voice, or a singer with such a voice

example.en: The soprano sang the leading role in the opera.
example.zh: 这位女高音在歌剧中担任主角。

senses.en: relating to the highest vocal or instrumental range

example.en: She plays soprano saxophone in the band.
example.zh: 她在乐队里演奏高音萨克斯。

senses.en: to require something because it is necessary or important

example.en: I need to buy some milk.
example.zh: 我需要买些牛奶。

senses.en: a thing that is necessary or required

example.en: The family's basic needs are food and shelter.
example.zh: 这个家庭的基本需求是食物和住所。

senses.en: every one of two or more people or things, considered separately

example.en: Each student received a book.
example.zh: 每个学生都拿到了一本书。

senses.en: every one individually

example.en: Each of the rooms has a window.
example.zh: 每个房间都有一扇窗户。

senses.en: for or to every one; apiece

example.en: The tickets cost ten dollars each.
example.zh: 每张票十美元。

senses.en: to provide food and drinks for an event as a business
senses.zh: 承办酒席；提供饮食服务

example.en: The restaurant will cater our wedding next month.
example.zh: 这家餐厅下个月将承办我们婚礼的酒席。

senses.en: to satisfy a need or provide what is wanted

example.en: The hotel caters to both business and leisure travelers.
example.zh: 这家酒店同时满足商务和休闲旅客的需求。

senses.en: the ability to withstand hardship, stress, or effort over a long time

example.en: Running a marathon requires great endurance.
example.zh: 跑马拉松需要很强的耐力。

senses.en: the fact of continuing to exist or survive despite difficulty

example.en: The endurance of the ancient bridge amazed the engineers.
example.zh: 这座古桥的持久耐用让工程师们惊叹。

senses.en: to spin or turn around quickly

example.en: The leaves whirled in the wind.
example.zh: 树叶在风中打着旋。

senses.en: to make something spin rapidly

example.en: She whirled the rope above her head.
example.zh: 她在头顶上抡动绳子。

senses.en: a spinning movement; a feeling of confusion or dizziness

example.en: My head was in a whirl after the long meeting.
example.zh: 漫长的会议结束后，我的脑子一片混乱。

senses.en: to wave or flap quickly and lightly

example.en: The bird fluttered its wings before taking off.
example.zh: 那只鸟起飞前扑动着翅膀。

senses.en: to move with quick, light, nervous movements
senses.zh: （因紧张而）快速颤动；怦怦直跳

example.en: Her heart began to flutter when she saw the message.
example.zh: 看到那条消息时，她的心跳开始怦怦加速。

senses.en: a quick, light trembling or flapping movement; a state of nervous excitement

example.en: The news caused quite a flutter in the office.
example.zh: 这消息在办公室里引起一阵不小的慌乱。

senses.en: a handle attached to an axle, turned to start an engine or make something move

example.en: He turned the crank to start the old engine.
example.zh: 他转动曲柄启动那台旧发动机。

senses.en: a person with strange or obsessive ideas; an eccentric or bad-tempered person

example.en: My uncle is a crank who complains about everything.
example.zh: 我叔叔是个怪人，事事都要抱怨。

senses.en: to turn a crank, or to start an engine by turning one; to crank up means to increase
senses.zh: 摇动曲柄；（用曲柄）启动；调高

example.en: She cranked up the volume to hear the music.
example.zh: 她把音量调大以便听清音乐。

senses.en: a sudden good idea or creative thought

example.en: She got the inspiration for her novel while walking by the sea.
example.zh: 她在海边散步时获得了写小说的灵感。

senses.en: a person or thing that encourages and motivates others

example.en: Her courage has been an inspiration to us all.
example.zh: 她的勇气一直激励着我们所有人。

senses.en: gratitude or thankful recognition of something someone has done

example.en: She smiled to show her appreciation of their help.
example.zh: 她微笑着表示对他们帮助的感谢。

senses.en: recognition and enjoyment of the good qualities of something; understanding of its value

example.en: Travel helped him develop an appreciation of different cultures.
example.zh: 旅行帮助他培养了对不同文化的欣赏。

senses.en: an increase in the value of money or assets

example.en: The appreciation of the currency made exports more expensive.
example.zh: 货币升值使出口商品更加昂贵。

senses.en: the soft thick hair covering an animal's body

example.en: The cat has soft brown fur.
example.zh: 这只猫有柔软的棕色皮毛。

senses.en: the treated skin of an animal with the hair, used to make clothing

example.en: She wore an expensive fur coat to the party.
example.zh: 她穿了一件昂贵的皮草大衣去参加聚会。

senses.en: producing good or helpful results

example.en: Regular exercise is beneficial to your health.
example.zh: 经常锻炼对你的健康有益。

senses.en: to interrupt the normal course of something

example.en: The storm disrupted flights across the region.
example.zh: 暴风雨扰乱了整个地区的航班。

senses.en: to fundamentally change an industry or market

example.en: New technology is disrupting the taxi industry.
example.zh: 新技术正在颠覆出租车行业。

senses.en: to break apart or cause something to stop working as a unit

example.en: The scandal disrupted the team's unity.
example.zh: 丑闻瓦解了团队的团结。

senses.en: a movement downward; the act of going down

example.en: The plane began its descent into the valley.
example.zh: 飞机开始向山谷降落。

senses.en: family origins or ancestry

example.en: She is of Irish descent.
example.zh: 她有爱尔兰血统。

senses.en: a decline to a worse or lower state

example.en: The film follows his descent into crime.
example.zh: 这部电影讲述了他堕入犯罪的过程。

senses.en: extremely beautiful, impressive, or grand

example.en: We watched a magnificent sunset over the lake.
example.zh: 我们观看了湖面上壮丽的日落。

senses.en: extremely good; excellent

example.en: She gave a magnificent speech at the ceremony.
example.zh: 她在典礼上发表了一场出色的演讲。

senses.en: an underground pipe that carries away waste water and sewage

example.en: Workers are repairing the old sewer under the street.
example.zh: 工人们正在修理街道下面陈旧的下水道。

senses.en: a person whose job is sewing

example.en: A skilled sewer can finish this dress quickly.
example.zh: 熟练的缝纫工可以很快完成这条裙子。

senses.en: to talk too proudly about yourself or your achievements

example.en: He keeps bragging about his new car.
example.zh: 他不停地吹嘘他的新车。

senses.en: a boastful statement

example.en: Saying you're the best player is just a brag.
example.zh: 说自己是最好的球员只是吹牛罢了。

senses.en: a god or goddess

example.en: The ancient temple was built to honor the river deity.
example.zh: 这座古庙是为祭祀河神而建的。

senses.en: an unexpected difficulty or problem

example.en: There was one snag with our travel plans: the flight was canceled.
example.zh: 我们的旅行计划遇到了一个意外问题：航班被取消了。

senses.en: a sharp rough object that tears or catches things

example.en: A snag on the old fence tore his sleeve.
example.zh: 旧篱笆上的一根尖刺扯破了他的袖子。

senses.en: to catch or tear on something rough

example.en: Her sweater snagged on a nail.
example.zh: 她的毛衣被钉子钩住了。

senses.en: to get or grab something quickly before others can

example.en: She snagged the last ticket to the concert.
example.zh: 她抢到了最后一张音乐会门票。

senses.en: deep respect for someone or something

example.en: The students showed reverence for their elderly professor.
example.zh: 学生们对年迈的教授表现出深深的敬意。

senses.en: to respect and admire someone or something deeply

example.en: Many people reverence the founders of the nation.
example.zh: 许多人崇敬国家的缔造者。

senses.en: allowed or accepted as valid, especially as evidence in court

example.en: The judge ruled that the tape was admissible as evidence.
example.zh: 法官裁定这盘录像带可作为证据采纳。

senses.en: a male servant in a large house, who serves meals and opens doors

example.en: A footman opened the carriage door for the guests.
example.zh: 一名男仆为客人打开马车车门。

senses.en: a substance used to produce cooling, as in refrigerators and air conditioners

example.en: The air conditioner needs a recharge of refrigerant.
example.zh: 这台空调需要补充制冷剂。

senses.en: a person who supports or takes part in colonialism

example.en: The historian examined the arguments made by colonialists.
example.zh: 历史学家研究了殖民主义者提出的论点。

senses.en: relating to or supporting colonialism

example.en: The article criticized colonialist policies.
example.zh: 这篇文章批评了殖民主义政策。

senses.en: the third letter of the Greek alphabet (Γ, γ)
senses.zh: 希腊字母表的第三个字母 Γ/γ

example.en: He drew the Greek letter gamma on the whiteboard.
example.zh: 他在白板上画了希腊字母γ。

senses.en: not interrupted or disturbed; calm and peaceful

example.en: The village remained undisturbed by the storm.
example.zh: 村庄没有受到风暴的打扰。

senses.en: to mix things together in a confused way

example.en: All his papers were jumbled together in a drawer.
example.zh: 他的文件全乱七八糟地混在一个抽屉里。

senses.en: a confused mixture of things

example.en: Her desk was a jumble of books and papers.
example.zh: 她的书桌上堆满了乱七八糟的书和文件。

senses.en: sums of money borrowed, usually to be repaid with interest

example.en: They applied for bank loans to start the business.
example.zh: 他们申请银行贷款来创办公司。

senses.en: gives something temporarily to someone

example.en: The museum loans artworks to other galleries.
example.zh: 这家博物馆向其他画廊出借艺术品。

senses.en: skills, knowledge, or certificates that make someone suitable for a job
senses.zh: 资格；资历；资格证书（qualification 的复数）

example.en: She has all the qualifications for the teaching post.
example.zh: 她具备这个教师职位所需的全部资格。

senses.en: statements that limit or soften a claim

example.en: He agreed, but with several qualifications.
example.zh: 他表示同意，但有几点保留条件。
